weaknesses: No persistent identifier (DOI/RRID); id is the project website URL
Human subjects confirmed but no IRB, consent/waiver, privacy-protection block or re-identification risk assessment
No version, version access, errata or update schedule
No named license or reuse permissions; no prohibited/discouraged uses
No known_biases, anomalies, missing-data documentation or data dictionary; no related datasets or publisher
recommendations: Mint a DOI for the released 50,000-admission dataset and record it alongside the id
Document IRB approvals/waivers per contributing site and the consent basis for retrospective extraction in ethical_reviews and informed_consent
Add participant_privacy with the de-identification standard, removed identifier classes and a residual risk assessment
Record a version number and a release/update policy for the growing dataset
Name the data licensing agreement's terms, add prohibited_uses, and link the OMOP data dictionary under variables
